# Meet Your Project 👋

#### Course: Whack A Mole

## Meet Your Project 👋

Welcome to Whack-a-Mole, a classic arcade game that is as fun to build as it is to play.

![Whack a Mole](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

In this project, you will create an interactive browser game where moles randomly pop up from holes and players race against the clock to click as many as they can.

It is simple, engaging, and packed with learning opportunities.

Here is what makes this project special. You are not just copying code. You are going to build this game from the ground up, make decisions, solve problems, and think like a real developer.

By the end, you'll have:

- A fully functional game you can play and share
- Hands-on experience with DOM manipulation
- A solid understanding of JavaScript events
- The confidence to build interactive web projects on your own
- A small portfolio-ready game project you can customize (difficulty, sounds).

Ready to dive in? Let's see what you'll learn along the way.

Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
